quests.title: The Weighed Tribute
quests.premise: Redistributed grain is short by the same fraction at every stage, so the loss is in the weighing rather than in the carrying

quests.title: A Death Inside the Grove
quests.premise: A delegate is dead inside a grove where no blade may be carried, so the question is what was carried instead

quests.title: The Blank Line in the Register
quests.premise: One stage of the passenger register carries a paid fare against a name the polers cannot place on any hull

quests.title: Seats Cut and Recut
quests.premise: Two tribes claim the same worn seat because one of them has cut its mark deeper than the other

quests.title: Cast, Not Tuned
quests.premise: Cast chimes are sold in the Helstrom market under a forged tuning mark, which makes half the district's prayers wrong

quests.title: Three Short and One Long
quests.premise: Something on the gate approach has learnt the lantern rhythm by which the basin guides answer each other

quests.title: The Sweet Water Turns
quests.premise: The city spring runs sour on a cycle the assembly declines to time in open session

quests.title: Light Sold by the Jar
quests.premise: Farmed gallery fungus enters the city untaxed under the assembly's own carrying licences

quests.title: The Poles by the Door
quests.premise: Finished grave-poles arrive at Helstrom houses that ordered none, cut with the names of the living

quests.title: The Unstood Turn
quests.premise: A rite needs a tribe that has missed three convocations, so the assembly must decide who may stand in its place

quests.title: Two Names on One Chair
quests.premise: A naheesh dies with the office promised to a child of eleven and claimed by a sister who has done the work for years

quests.title: The Owing Paid in Passage
quests.premise: A porter works an Owing off in rootworm fares that the ledger keeps re-entering at the start

quests.title: Written on the Urn
quests.premise: A Helstrom family's name is shelved in the vault under an offence that was pardoned two generations ago

quests.title: Four Hundred and Eleven
quests.premise: The refuge stores are counted for a population last surveyed forty years ago, so somebody must walk out and count them again

quests.title: The Fare or the Favour
quests.premise: The Waykeepers will carry the assembly's grain at a price the assembly cannot pay in coin

quests.title: It Keeps Its Circle
quests.premise: The ground stays bare two metres out from the standing thing; two of the four stories about it turn that to profit

quests.title: The Lifted Rota
quests.premise: A stage has been cut out of the tending rota carved down the door jamb, taking three hundred years of turns with it

quests.title: The Grove's Own Shade
quests.premise: A market row's roofing is killing a grove limb, so the traders and the tree-minders each hold a case the assembly must hear

quests.title: The Line That Ends Early
quests.premise: The lamp-keeper's round on the semi-public underway now stops at the first junction rather than the second

quests.title: The Roost Moves
quests.premise: Two hundred birds have shifted their dawn line onto the grove approach and take whatever the market carries

quests.title: A Second Timetable
quests.premise: The working rootworm exit runs an hour that its honest posted timetable leaves out

quests.title: The Sermon a Day Short
quests.premise: A Nisswo has painted a sermon inside the last rest house that the assembly wants gone before the convocation

quests.title: The Chime That Names the Heir
quests.premise: A household's inheritance turns on a chime tuned to a tree that has since been felled

quests.title: Held for the Season
quests.premise: A debtor is held under a custom that lapses when the convocation closes, which is why the convocation keeps being postponed

quests.title: The Sky Cut Open
quests.premise: The stones that keep a sky-view for the convocation have begun disagreeing with the season they are cut to read

quests.title: Tuned Against a Dead Tree
quests.premise: A chime was commissioned for a tree that died between the order and the tuning, leaving both parties out of pocket

quests.title: The Withdrawn Qualification
quests.premise: A maker's tuning qualification was pulled six years ago on a ruling issued by word only

quests.title: The Frame That Answers
quests.premise: One frame in the field of two hundred rings without wind, on a pattern somebody has begun writing down

quests.title: Three Claims on One Egg
quests.premise: Three tribes claim a share of the Mnemic Egg, one of them publicly, so refusal now looks like hoarding

quests.title: The Egg Room Opened
quests.premise: The reliquary inside the dead trunk was opened from within the village, by somebody who knew the order of the wrappings

quests.title: What the Dead Trunk Holds
quests.premise: The trunk the village refuses to leave has begun answering at night, in a voice the custodians will not describe

quests.title: The Maintenance Ledger
quests.premise: The keepers' repair ledger bills four tribes for spans left unrebuilt

quests.title: Under the Fourth Arm
quests.premise: Something has taken up residence beneath the deck that carries the shrine, at the arm the village uses least

quests.title: A Rate the Tribes Will Wear
quests.premise: Two junctions have begun coordinating their tolls, so the tribes that use both want one rate or none at all

quests.title: The Sapling's First Naming
quests.premise: The carried cutting is old enough for children to be named at it, with no agreement on who may stand for a tree that young

quests.title: Two Days of Root
quests.premise: The replanted sapling is failing, which puts the soil it was carried in under suspicion two days back along the walk

quests.title: Water Without Ceremony
quests.premise: Two tribes camped here on principle want the spring's use written down before the next convocation

quests.title: The Drinker at the Spring
quests.premise: A body is in the water that the interior drinks without ceremony, which two households at the spring would rather nobody raised

quests.title: Grain Counted Twice
quests.premise: Two villages hold receipts against the same stored grain, both stamped by the same storekeeper

quests.title: The Staddle Post Cut
quests.premise: A granary is emptied with its lock untouched, which narrows the field to whoever knew the post's weak side

quests.title: Stored Against a Person
quests.premise: A village has pledged a household's labour against its grain deposit, without telling the household

quests.title: New Courses on Old Stone
quests.premise: The tribe laying fresh courses on Merethic stone is called to answer for it in front of the convocation

quests.title: Consecrating Bad Work
quests.premise: A Nisswo is asked to bless courses the masons themselves admit are worse than the Merethic stone beneath them

quests.title: The Plan Behind the Stone
quests.premise: The new courses have begun completing a plan drawn before the current masons were born

quests.title: Born Onto the Roster
quests.premise: A child entered on the watch roster at birth wants off it, which the village treats as desertion

quests.title: Behind the Sealed Door
quests.premise: What the village guards can be reached without its leave, past the ward that holds the dry approach

quests.title: The Pole Not Collected
quests.premise: A finished grave-pole has stood by the door for eleven years because the family it names cannot be found

quests.title: Cord and Paint
quests.premise: Grave-pole cord is being rebound with the wrong tribal marks, which enters the dead in the wrong ledger

quests.title: Led by the Wrist
quests.premise: A visitor walked through the village on the chime-lines arrives lighter, unable to describe what left

quests.title: The Chime-Lines Sicken
quests.premise: Somebody is fouling the chime-lines with a paste that dulls them, in a village that steers by them after dark

quests.title: Pitch-Rights
quests.premise: The village rents convocation pitch at a rate that has sent two delegations to camp elsewhere

quests.title: One Tree or Nine
quests.premise: A felling claim turns on whether the ring is one tree by the Hist's reckoning or nine by the tribes' reckoning

quests.title: Under the Overflow
quests.premise: Goods move into the convocation inside delegation baggage the village is paid not to open

quests.title: Four Villages Down
quests.premise: The pile stumps of four earlier villages still hold what each left. The water has dropped far enough to reach them

quests.title: The Fifth Set of Piles
quests.premise: Piles are being driven at night in the old field, for a village with no builder behind it

quests.title: Under the Stumps
quests.premise: Something dens in the drowned pile fields and takes from the village standing above them

quests.title: Boards That Disagree
quests.premise: Every house keeps its own toll board, so a carrier who used four landings has been charged four different ways

quests.title: Off the Landing Ladder
quests.premise: A toll collector drowns at his own ladder in water a metre deep, with his board freshly repainted

quests.title: The House With No Board
quests.premise: One house takes no landing fee. After dark it is busier than the poling quay

quests.title: The Concession Runs Out
quests.premise: A lapsed Imperial concession is being enforced over the warehouse stock by factors holding no writ

quests.title: Named by Register
quests.premise: A naming that a Hist would witness must be done by register and witness, with one of the witnesses refusing to sign

quests.title: The Dry Magazine
quests.premise: The interior's dry magazine is storing cargo that the station's own register declines to list
